title: Docker Container Restart-Loop Detection
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=docker:stats
| stats max(restart_count) as restarts, latest(status) as status by container_name
| streamstats current=f last(restarts) as prev by container_name
| eval delta=restarts-coalesce(prev,restarts)
| where delta>3
| sort - delta
description: Detects containers that are crash-looping by watching their restart counter climb, catching a broken self-hosted app before you notice it is down.
value: A crash-looping container quietly burns resources and stays offline; catching the restart pattern points you straight at the failing service.
implementation: Forward Docker stats/events to HEC; schedule every few minutes and alert on rapidly rising restart counts.
visualization: Table of containers by recent restart count.
grandmaExplanation: It spots when one of your self-hosted apps keeps crashing and restarting, so you can fix it.
